title: Recognising and Recording Achievements
text: Explore how to record and reflect on your achievements, linking them to personal growth and future goals.
cdi_links: 3.G.04 Recognising and reflecting on achievements and their impact on future development

title: Introduction
text: In this lesson, you will explore
bullets: How to recognise your achievements
Why reflection is important
How achievements link to personal growth
How reflecting can support future goals

title: Success Criteria
bullets: I can identify my achievements
I can explain what I learned from my experiences
I can describe how achievements support personal growth
I can link achievements to future goals

title: Key Words
bullets: Personal Growth – Learning and improving through experiences and challenges
Resilience – The ability to keep going and bounce back after difficulties
Achievement – Something you have successfully completed or accomplished
Reflection – Thinking about what you have done and what you have learned

title: Quick Questions
text: What is something you have achieved recently?
How did you feel when you achieved it?
Why is it important to remember your achievements?

title: Recognising Achievements
bullets: Achievements can be big or small
They include school work, personal goals, and new skills
Recognising achievements helps build confidence
It shows what you are capable of achieving

title: Reflection and Growth
bullets: Reflection means thinking about what you have done and learned
It helps you understand your strengths and areas to improve
Linking achievements to goals keeps you motivated
Every challenge you overcome supports personal growth

title: Activity
text: Take part in activities that involve recalling recent learning, identifying achievements, and reflecting on what you have learned. Consider how your achievements link to personal growth and how they may support your future goals.

title: Key Takeaways
text: Reflection helps you understand your progress
Linking achievements to goals supports motivation
Personal growth comes from learning through experience
